scope: Exploratory counterfactual diagnostic, not the unopened final cohort. Geometry-only selection before inspecting any trained checkpoint.

scene.book_collision_scope: Fixed, nonsliding book terrain; visual meshes and collision envelopes share the same placements. No root motion is authored.
scene.revision_notes: Post-it stack removed from physics and rendering. Drawer-to-laptop transit is ordinary flat walking.

base.scope: Phase A flat navigation; existing 8 mm book steps remain obstacles. Height/traversal variants require a separate validated gate.

envelope.scope: Conservative yaw-invariant disk enclosing measured neutral collision geometry plus a declared swing/tracking allowance. Physical trials remain necessary.

geometric_validation.scope: Frozen geometric filter only; no learned policy or execution outcome used.
